notablePrerequisites: Watchers of the Dead has at least one Equipment attached.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Watchers of the Dead, adding {C}{C}.
Watchers of the Dead dies, triggering Koll, returning Watchers of the Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Watchers of the Dead by paying {2}.
Watchers of the Dead enters the battlefield, triggering Kemba, attaching any Equipment you control to it.
Repeat.
